# EXP-ECDLP-95f69f
# Low-bit image sizes for addition mod 17 and mod 4.
# Approved by DEC-20261001-9549fe.
experiment:
  id: EXP-ECDLP-95f69f
  hypothesis_id: H-ECDLP-7bd5f5
  source_idea: IDEA-20260920-a5757d
  question_id: RQ-ECDLP-bc7a54
  version: 1
  title: Branching of 2-bit reduction after addition modulo 17
  status: approved
  frozen: true
  designed_at: '2026-10-01'
  approved_by: coordinator
  approval_decision_id: DEC-20261001-9549fe
  objective: >-
    For every pair of residues mod 4, list the 2-bit reductions of all sums
    modulo 17 with those residues, and of all sums modulo 4. Count
    homomorphism mismatches.
  inputs:
    N: 17
    M: 4
    predicted:
      residue_pairs: 16
      mod17_image_size: 2
      mod17_mismatches: 136
      mod17_pairs: 289
      mod4_image_size: 1
      mod4_mismatches: 0
  controls:
    - Addition modulo 4 is the homomorphism control. An image size other than 1 there invalidates the run.
    - Two loop orders. They must not import each other.
  independent_variables:
    - modulus in {17, 4}
    - loop order
  metrics:
    primary:
      - mod17_image_sizes
      - mod17_mismatches
      - mod4_image_sizes
      - mod4_mismatches
      - implementations_agree
    secondary:
      - residue_pairs
  heuristic_under_test: null
  preregistered_prediction:
    quantity: Image sizes and mismatch counts.
    formula: >-
      low(x) = x mod 4. A mismatch is low((a+b) mod N) different from
      (low(a)+low(b)) mod 4.
    source: >-
      Design-time enumeration on 2026-10-01. IDEA-20260920-a5757d claim (A)
      was read. No curve arithmetic was done. The enumeration is not a run
      of this experiment.
  scale_relevance:
    tier: toy
    justification: Modulus 17 and 2 output bits. No transfer to a k-tree.
    correspondence: null
  tail_checks:
    - All 289 pairs modulo 17 are visited. A sample is not a pass.
  replication:
    seeds: []
    independent_instances: 1
    replication_note: Deterministic. The second run swaps the loop order.
  budget:
    enforcement: advisory
    wall_clock_seconds_per_run: null
    total_cpu_hours: null
    maximum_memory_gb: 1
    maximum_runs: 2
    maximum_workers: 1
  stopping_rules:
    - Stop after two runs.
    - If a mod-4 image size is not 1, mark the attempt invalid.
    - A crash is incomplete, not a negative result.
  invalidation_rules:
    - Either loop imports the other.
    - A mod-4 image size is not 1.
    - A k-tree, a curve, or a discrete logarithm is reported.
  success_criterion: >-
    Both runs agree, every mod-17 image has size 2, there are 136 mod-17
    mismatches out of 289 pairs, and every mod-4 image has size 1 with 0
    mismatches.
  falsification_criterion: >-
    The runs agree, the mod-4 control has image size 1, and some mod-17
    image does not have size 2 or the mismatch count is not 136.
  required_artifacts:
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/manifest.yaml
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/command.txt
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/stdout.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/stderr.log
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/raw-result.json
    - experiments/EXP-ECDLP-95f69f/runs/<RUN-ID>/certificate.yaml
  assigned_to: executor
  out_of_scope:
    - The larger moduli in the proposal's stage 1.
    - Elliptic curves and k-trees.
    - The CERTBIN pricing design withheld by DEC-20261001-92f749.
